## December 2024: vow to escalate against the Houthis

On a Sunday in December 2024, following a ballistic missile strike on a Tel Aviv playground over the weekend, Netanyahu warned that [[israel]] would act against the [[houthis|Houthi]] rebels in Yemen with the same force it had used against [[iran]]'s other "terrorist arms," appearing to signal a stepped-up campaign against the Islamic Republic's proxy group.[{n}] In a video statement issued after a security cabinet meeting in the northern Israeli town of Safed, he stressed that Israel was not alone, pointing to repeated American and British strikes on Houthi targets over the previous year: "The US, and also other countries, like us, see the Houthis as a threat, not only to world shipping, but also to world order."[{n}] "Just as we acted forcefully against the terrorist arms of Iran's evil axis, so we will act against the Houthis...with force, determination and sophistication," the premier said.[{n}]

Israeli reports at the same time said senior defense officials, including the head of the [[mossad|Mossad]], believed the correct move was to attack Iran directly rather than target its Yemeni proxy.[{n}] Badlands writer [[ghostofbasedpatrickhenry|GhostofBasedPatrickHenry]] responded by counting Israeli ground operations in at least three foreign territories — Lebanon, Syria and Palestine, or four theaters counting Gaza and the West Bank separately — and suggesting the [[israel-defense-forces|Israeli Defense Force]] be renamed the "Israeli Offense Force."[{n}] He further argued it was incoherent for Netanyahu to urge Iranians to overthrow their government while Israeli-attributed strikes on Iranian gas pipelines deprived millions of basic amenities amid the country's energy crisis.[{n}]
